connector.name: WinstonRedGuard MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: WinstonRedGuard monorepo bridge for MCP agents: governance, pipelines, memory, OSINT tools.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package wrg-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the wrg-11 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: WRG_REPO_ROOT
env.description: Absolute path to the WinstonRedGuard monorepo checkout. Required when the package is installed outside the repo (the server auto-detects when run from inside the repo).

env.name: WRG_MCP_ALLOW_MUTATIONS
env.description: Set to '1' to permit state-changing tools (memory_set, pipeline_run). Default '0' = read-only.

env.name: WRG_SITE_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL of the optional company-site API (enables site_* tools). Requires the `[remote]` extra.

env.name: WRG_SITE_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token for the company-site API.

env.name: WRG_PULSEBOARD_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL of the optional PulseBoard dashboard API (enables pulseboard_* tools). Requires the `[remote]` extra.

env.name: WRG_PULSEBOARD_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token for the PulseBoard API.
